Metadata.title: OpenSEO — open-source SEO platform
Metadata.description: Rank tracking, site audits, competitor research and white-label reports on affordable API data. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

Landing.title: SEO insights without the enterprise price tag
Landing.subtitle: Track rankings, audit sites, reverse-engineer competitors and send white-label client reports — built on transparent, pay-as-you-go search data.

rank.title: Rank tracking
rank.body: Daily positions per country, language and device, including AI Overviews and other SERP features.

audit.title: Site audits
audit.body: Crawl your site, find technical issues and check AI-readiness with a health score.

competitors.title: Competitor gap
competitors.body: See the keywords competitors rank for and where you are missing or weak.

reports.title: White-label reports
reports.body: Branded web and PDF reports for clients, in English, Finnish or Swedish.

Landing.pricingSubtitle: Prices exclude VAT. Paid plans can go over their quotas with metered billing.

Login.title: Sign in to OpenSEO
